notes.title: Tanzia Gets a Free Demo!
notes.content:
Hey, everybody! 

We know that some people are on the verge of getting Tanzia, but they'd like to try it first. So we've just released a Tanzia FREE DEMO on Steam!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8805370/b077fd3317e498a0347f5c31d6bfeb01aa3aaa8b.png[/img]

The demo lets you play until the Docks chapter, so you'll get the chance to fight 2 mini bosses and upgrade your gear, check some sidequests and even one of the comic books!
Also your demo savegames will transfer to the full version if you upgrade, so don't worry about losing your progress!

If you haven't bought the game yet, feel free to try the demo, and if you already have the game, please tell everyone you know!

We've also updated the main version of the game with some new stuff, a few bugfixes, and also some things our players requested.

Some of the main changes are:

-Added "kid" difficulty, so it's easier for the young ones to complete the game and enjoy the full story.
-Increased the strafe and strafe jump speed.
-Added super widescreen resolutions.
-Added more key remap options (equipment, spellbook, etc).

Let us know what you think in the comments or in our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/arcanity]Discord channel![/url]

notes.title: 03/28/2019 FULL LAUNCH!
notes.content:
After 2 years in Early Access (and over 5 years of development time!), we're finally ready to release Tanzia, IN A WEEK! [b]March 28th is the day![/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8805370/e49a14b83481940669f4f79d12494165d413df75.gif[/img]

Since April 2017 when Tanzia was released in Early Access (and also later on Nintendo Switch), we listened to our players –to those who loved the game, and especially to those who hated it.

We took a long hard look at what we had and decided to improve and polish every single area of the game: the animations, melee combat, spells, gem system, crafting...
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/369700/announcements/detail/1735477928466828903](Please read our prior post for more detail on some of the changes)[/url]

So the players who loved the old systems will now have a lot of new things to discover and master, and those who dismissed it then can now give it a fresh look, and hopefully change their minds.

To celebrate the launch, we made two new mini trailers to showcase the combat and exploration aspects of Tanzia. Here they are:

Action Trailer
https://youtu.be/3FdBzX9ow1s

Exploration Trailer
https://youtu.be/BW-X7j5zocY

Those who already own the game can try the beta on Steam and check out the new content right now. On March 28th the full game will unlock for everyone!

We're also working on updating the Switch build with all this new content and also the localizations.

We want to thank everyone who supported us during this long development time, all the people who made LetsPlays of the beta/EA builds, those who after all this time still asks us regularly how the game is doing, and all the friends we made along the way!

Thank you!

notes.title: OMG! It's almost here!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

After we released on Switch and Steam Early Access, we took all the feedback we received to heart. We heard it all, comments about melee being weak, people not liking the floating combat text, the animations being too generic...
We know it took a long time to fix all that, but hopefully when you see all the new stuff we added to Tanzia, you'll forgive us! : )

So let me walk you through some of the biggest changes.

[h1][b]Animations[/b][/h1]
We remade most of the main character's animations, everything from run, jump, directional damage, spellcasting, etc. We now even have proper walk, strafe and jump melee animations and directional spellcasting!
Everything looks new and fresh!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8805370/4214d4eed55fe62472f4bca88573775d53d673cf.png[/img]
[i]Check out my fancy new fall animation![/i]

[h1][b]Combat[/b][/h1]
We've spent a lot of time improving melee combat and combat in general. The hits are sharper, more impactful, and more responsive with directional damage animations, subtle screen shakes and controller vibrations. You can feel every impact, and you can see the enemies reacting accordingly. You're still a shaman, and spells will always be your main form of attack, but now you won't feel like a wimp when out of mana.

[h1][b]Gems[/b][/h1]
We did a major revision on gems. We added several new artifact gems, remade the effects on some that were previously not super useful, and made all of them drop sooner (no Great Volcano gem drops anymore). 

There's a new NPC at The Docks who tells you what every artifact gem actually does (it used to be trial and error, you needed to test each gem to see its effect).

We also made a full set of gems called "Eye of the ..." which actually improve your spells! You can get a bigger fireball, faster Ice Shard, monstrous Fire Totems, and a killer Thunderclap!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8805370/0710dcbc4b5967300ba1865aa6f925f89647d446.png[/img]
[i]The Giant Fire Totems to the right are the improved versions you get with the Eye Of The Summoner Gem.[/i]

The new Alchemist's Gem gives you the possibility to craft improved versions of potions.   

And now we have a portable Jeweler's Kit that lets you switch your gems anytime!

[h1][b]Spells[/b][/h1]
We've improved some of the spell FX. More importantly we revamped the spells at the Voodoo Camp. Fear is now a point-blank AOE spell like Thunderclap. Web Totem has been removed entirely and replaced with my new favorite spell, Raise Dead! With it you get your own posse of freshly deceased monsters to follow you around, killing everything in your way. In normal use you only get 3 of them, but just imagine mixing it up with Mako's Rage... you can get a whole army!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8805370/86a36b5b9b3a69c1ee5337fe4017e3ae26328f56.png[/img]
[i]You don't have to imagine it anymore, check out my beautiful army of the dead![/i]

[h1][b]Steam Achievements[/b][/h1]
You can now show the world how good you are at Tanzia!

[h1][b]A NEW COMIC![/b][/h1]
We already had one quest which gives you a full digital comic book as a reward, but now we have another comic with even more backstory, and you can get it right away at The Village!

[h1][b]And More![/b][/h1]
We have tons of little improvements we're not mentioning in detail here, but expect tweaked loot locations, monsters showing directional damage, the ability to remove floating text, more items to loot, better tutorial windows for each control type, improved controller support, no more cooldown for potions, new FX for some of the spells, monsters now have hitboxes instead of infinite reach and bug fixes galore!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8805370/2104045934f6fc301652b44915f35a315fcec05e.png[/img]
[i]New Fireball FX![/i]

[h1][b]Try the Beta before launch![/b][/h1]
This version is available to everyone right now in the beta branch. You might run into a bug or ten, so this is only for the adventurous folk out there.
We have a [url=https://discord.gg/VdVhFM3]Discord channel[/url] were you can post about any bugs you find in the beta, or if you just want to talk to us. We're friendly!

[h1][b]Launch and Early Access discounts[/b][/h1]
As we mentioned before, Tanzia's final price will be $19.99, right now you can buy it at $14.99 during EA, but in order to be able to feature a launch discount, we need to increase the price at least 30 days before the full release.
You have until Friday, February 8th to buy it at $14.99, after that we're increasing it to $19.99, so [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/369700/Tanzia/]it's a great time to buy Tanzia with a big discount![/url]

We're working on a release candidate now and we'll announce the full release date soon. Stay tuned for any updates!

Thank you for reading!

notes.title: Tanzia Comic Books! (And How To Get One)
notes.content:
Hey all,

You might have already heard that we have a couple of Tanzia comics. The story is a big focus in Tanzia and we had a lot of fun creating and telling it. So we had the idea that comics would let us focus on specific parts of the story in more detail. Also Saige and I always wanted to make a comic book :) The first comic tells the story of Grandfather Mako's discovery of Arcanity and his original battle with The Skeleton King. The 2nd comic continues later some years after the first and fills in some details about Grandfather's disappearance. I'm really happy with how both comics came out. I wish we had the time and resources to do more. I had so much fun with them honestly after doing the first 2 comics I wanted to make a series of 10 or 20 comic books that tells the whole story arc of Grandfather and The Young Hero.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8805370/2447c2a1c5ed96f95aa8b285b693b7cf8e1da3b3.png[/img]
[i]Tanzia #1 and #2 covers.[/i]

The 2nd comic unlocks in game when you collect all of the Lost Pages of Grandfather's Journal.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8805370/74165791b025121ebc83d391b924066633e149d9.png[/img]
[i]A panel from Tanzia #1[/i]

The 1st comic you can get right now if you pre-order Tanzia on either Steam or Nintendo Switch. Just forward your digital receipt to [b]promo@arcanity.com[/b] and we'll send you the 1st comic as a PDF file. If you can't find the receipt, snap a screenshot of Tanzia in your game library and email that to us. You also get a discount for buying the game early in most regions (We had an issue setting up the store for Nintendo of Europe and couldn't get the discount set up in time there.)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8805370/6a543289ddc4e08d7816243266db98df58c45383.png[/img]
[i]Taken from Tanzia #2[/i]

I'm anxious to hear what everyone thinks of the first comic. So pre-order Tanzia now and email that receipt to us. Then let us know right here if you liked it.

-Jason

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qPyKrmSEYHM

https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/tanzia-switch

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8805370/73aa9d0f3558580acb362f2c889cd95e84a0f227.png[/img]

(the Americas pre-sale is live, but the Europe+Australia one will be live the first week of July.)

[list]
[*]We've spent most of the last year on optimizations, polish, and lots of QA. The user experience is greatly improved all around compared to the beta.

[*]Gamepad controls are awesome now! This is also thanks to the Nintendo Switch build. We spent months optimizing controls for the console and now the Steam build benefits from that.

notes.title: Comic books, ports, OMG! So much to do!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

       We have some big news we want to share with you.
First of all, the Steam version of Tanzia is coming along fine, we're finishing the ending area, working on some localizations and polishing the whole game so it looks awesome at launch.

[b]Also, some news we're really excited about: Tanzia is also coming to the Nintendo Switch![/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8805370/25e414b524ab9df2bd034275dc14bb58da534a82.png[/img]
[i]A very early mockup of what touch controls could look like on the Switch.[/i]

That also sadly means that the Steam version of Tanzia needs to be pushed back a little bit : (

We've been given the opportunity to launch on the Switch in the coming months, and to be able to make it, we need to focus 100% on that build. Since we're developing the game using Unity3D, improvements to the Switch version will also be reflected on the Steam build. So you'll see gamepad control improvements, faster loading and smoother scene transitions, higher frame rates, and more!

[b]Pricing & Comic Books.[/b]
At first we planned on having a regular $15 edition of Tanzia, and then a $20 Special Edition with comic books and additional content, but we decided to include that comic book in-game as an unlockable (remember those bottles at the beach? Yeah, those will unlock the comic book in the future) and have a regular and beefier normal edition at $20.
So Tanzia for Steam and NIntendo Switch will be $20 at launch. However, as a thank you to the people supporting us right now, we're keeping the $15 price during Early Access!
So if you're on the fence about buying the game now or after the full launch, get it now and save $5. You can also tell your hipster friends you were into Tanzia before it was even launched, and that's priceless!

So here's today's news in bullet point form:

[list]
[*]Tanzia is premiering on the Nintendo Switch!

[*]The Switch version will make the PC version even better.

[*]The PC version will need to be pushed back a little bit because of that : (

[*]We're adding an awesome looking comic book as an in-game unlockable : ) 

[*]The price is going from $15 to $20 at release. There's still time to get it at the discounted price during Early Access

[*]Did I mention the comic book was drawn by our awesome artist Saige, who also did all the in-game visions and intro?

[*]Also, bullet points are my favorite way of listing information.
[/list]

Thank you everyone for being so patient and understanding!

notes.title: This is Getting Serious
notes.content:
So far you´ve been running around beautiful beaches with sunny skies, facing not so difficult enemies, sailing boats, having a breezy time... THAT'S OVER!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8805370/c593861770d49b60751dc0973dfada7fa0b2931e.png[/img]
This update will finally let you open the mysterious courtyard door.
What will you find there? Death probably, but also a way into the Ancient Temple. So forget about those beautiful sunny beaches. This is the first step into the Skeleton King's lair, and nothing's going to be the same once you take it.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8805370/7c2c57d0a8360424bea036cabcb87f184f5df532.png[/img]
Stock up on potions, max your gear, level up and learn all the spells you can. You're going to need it all to survive!

Full changelog for build #3219 below:

8/16/2017 P4 #3219
-Open the Temple Ruins courtyard and The Ancient Temple.
-fix a bug preventing you from equipping fear with a gamepad.
-set quest items to disallow critical loot.
-redo collision on Bear Island so you can walk into the shallow beach areas.
-fix a bug where inventory counts sometimes are showing on empty slots due to UILocalize component overwriting empty text on UILabel.
-add missing reverb and fog volumes to library.
-fix portrait camera bugs on some mobs.
-add sound fx to doors and gates in Temple Ruins, Ancient Temple, and Great Volcano.
-collision optimizations for all mobs.
-pathing fixes and optimizations in Emuri Village.
-many optimizations to the scene graph.

notes.title: We listen to you!
notes.content:
Since launching on Early Access we've heard two main complains: the kill 10 Akiri birds in 10 seconds quest is too hard, and the kill 3 turtles with 1 fireball one is frustrating.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8805370/81cfdb561ed5c5b0189739b50ecf4795e38449f5.png[/img]
[i]"boom shakalaka"[/i]

[b]Oh no! There's a timer![/b]
We love the first Akiri Birds quest, we think it's a good challenge and while being hard, it used to give players the tools they need to face the rest of the game. So when we were watching LetsPlay videos or streams, we'd see them dying a few times on it, but then they'd go on and kill all the skeletons at the Docks in one try.

But we also saw a lot of people experiencing that quest as a literal wall. They'd just die over and over again, getting super frustrated in the process, and sometimes simply quitting the game since they saw no way around it.

So instead of asking you to kill 10 birds in 10 seconds, now the quest only asks you to kill more than 1 bird with 1 attack.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8805370/32dfd489a509577968de3a4ae9a68cf03334736b.png[/img]
[i]"Sorry about the super hard quest, dude!"[/i]

Wording is key here, since the player needs to do pretty much the same thing (get gold by killing a few birds or gathering reagents and then selling them to buy the fireball spell, learn said spell, and then roast some more birds with it).
Except that before, by giving players a timer, we were making them throw caution to the wind, and they'd go right in among all the birds, aggroing them all at the same time, but without the proper tools to win the fight.
Now without the timer we're hoping that they'll go "My staff and Ice Shard can only attack 1 bird at a time, so the only way to go is to buy the Fireball spell" instead of "I'm sure there's a way to kill 10 of these guys in 10 seconds with just the staff and Ice Shard!," which was absolutely impossible.

It's still impossible, but now we don't give the players any hope that they'll be able to do it without upgrading their gear! ; )

AND since we still love the quest, and we have a perfectly good timer programmed in, we kept it as an optional sidequest!
(Go talk to the new guy by the birds)

[b]Kill 3 Turtles with one Fireball[/b]
When we designed this quest, the game had no critical hits, no misses or almost any kind of damage variables: a hit was a hit. So you'd be able to really measure how much health each turtle had and then finish them off at the same time with a neat Fireball.
You also had the option to pull 5 or so turtles instead of just 3 to make it even easier.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8805370/4e2e295e7672094ee54149cf31f651c893674276.png[/img]
[i]Just a nice turtle ecosystem, until you show up with your fireballs and stuff![/i]

The game had only a very rudimentary tutorial back then, so the turtle questline was designed to introduce players to higher level fighting (it still does in a way, but now it's not as critical as it used to be).

So after the game evolved, that specific quest ended up requiring the player to pull at least 5 or 6 turtles every time, to compensate for all the damage variables (and even doing that, we saw players having to restart it a few times because the game was trolling them and 3 turtles would never die at the same time).

Also the questline later asks the player to kite all 9 turtles at the beach, so it made that quest a little redundant since some players were already pulling all 9 to finish the 3 turtle quest.

For this quest we pondered about ways to fix it, removing damage variables during it, removing the request to have them die at the same time and other things. But we decided to simply remove the sub quest itself. So now that whole questline is shorter and flows better.

So we hope this shows that we listen to you! We really do! We watch every single LetsPlay video and we try to watch all Twitch streams live (we sometimes can't because of timezone issues). We read your comments here on Steam and everything you write us on [url=https://twitter.com/playtanzia]Twitter[/url] or [url=https://www.facebook.com/ArcanityInc/]Facebook[/url].
This doesn't mean we'll turn Tanzia into a sidescroller shoot 'em up because some random person told us that's what they really want though! : D
It means that we appreciate your input, and we're always listening!

This new build also fixes a few bugs and other things! Read all about it on the full changelog below:

7/14/2017 P4 #3170
-adjustments to Abenaki's Challenge intro quest to make it less cryptic.
-add the original Abenaki's Challenge as an optional side quest.
-remove Kurame's 3-turtle quest. It became redundant with the addition of crits and resists and people didn't like it.
-open up Temple Ruins!
-open Sinking Island!
-open The Ancient Library!
-add an NPC who tells you where to catch the boat.
-FIX: Using Gamepad, if you select a side quest in the journal and then complete it, you can no longer select items in the journal.
-FIX: The cliffs on the sides of The Lagoon beach are bare.
-fix bug where people are jumping right off the boat dock and into the water at Bear Island.
-FIX: Can pass the collision wall by following the water line from The Docks to Turtle Beach.
-fix some Forgotten Jungle NPC chatter issues.
-lower the artifact gem prices so you can't sell 2 gems and buy a castle.
-update collision models in Emuri Village so you can't jump through the roof.
-make Emuri in Emuri Camp say things.
-make Diplomatic Immunity NPCs say meaningful things if you speak to them out of turn.
-FIX: remove the vial of water from inventory after giving it to Tika.
-FIX: don't let player walk on water in Forgotten Jungle.
-clear the Trigger flag on all water. Use layers to avoid water collision instead.
-fix Emuri guard and captain display names in Emuri Camp.

notes.title: Welcome to the Jungle!
notes.content:
The Forgotten Jungle is now live!

You can finally use the Scroll of Disenchantment to open the old sealed path to the Forgotten Jungle. I won't spoil all the surprises, but you better bring a lot of bug spray!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8805370/6ca9d782fe2963d145753aecc973fea360b5e888.png[/img]
One of our favorite sidequests is in this area, and it's the [b]"So Many Spiders"[/b] challenge!
You think you're good at killing things in Tanzia? Are you the very best, like no one ever was? Then find Ki'olda and give it a try!
We have online leaderboards for this quest, so you can challenge your friends, family and random strangers to it!
And if you want to brag about it, you can check the scores here:

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/stats/369700/leaderboards/1869385/]So Many Spiders Online Leaderboards[/url]

CapitalVices is the man to beat! [url=https://twitter.com/playtanzia] Let us know on Twitter [/url] if you managed to best him and we'll RT you to our almost 10k followers... You could be a star! XD

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8805370/b5851eae6a992652884b8445eab9ed804d3a25ea.png[/img]
This area also features one of the only quests that can be finished using Diplomacy. Can you reach Grog, the leader of the Emuri Camp, without firing a single fireball? A wrong answer means certain death on this quest! (or at least a pretty tough fight). So choose wisely!

-open Forgotten Jungle.

-add collision to emuri camp fort walls.

-major optimizations for new quest "Too Many Spiders".

-double Grog damage when hammer is equipped.

notes.title: Build #2863 Small but Important Update
notes.content:
Hey everybody! This time we're releasing one of the most requested features and some very important general fixes and balancing. Let me walk you through them.

[b]Sell items[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8805370/4225e28a9230da73d3076fa75e845a08e26a40d5.png[/img]
Since version 00001 everyone with access to the game have been asking us to let them sell unused items and reagents, and now it's finally possible! Every merchant in the game has a little sell icon, click on it and it switches to your inventory, easy!
And no, you can't sell the whistle, we have plans for it ; )

[b]Steam Cloud Saves[/b]
Everyone hates losing progress, now with cloud saves that's a thing of the past! It's like we live in the future!

[b]Boss music[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8805370/e8ece8bf0e712ee6f45d9d632910c4cd7b741e68.jpg[/img]
[i]Not this boss[/i]
Everything is more exciting with boss music right?

We're getting so close to the Early Access launch announcement you guys! We can practically taste it... Stay tuned!

Here's the full changelog for build #2863

4/4/2017 P4 #2863
-add "sell to merchants" functionality.
-add xp bonus/penalty depending on monster's level diff.
-add Steam cloud saves.
-add boss music.
-added environment/discovery music for some zones that were missing music.
-big final pass on Alchemy.
  -removed silver, brittlebright, and crispin's glove.
  -rebalanced recipes.
  -added reagent spawns to some bare areas.
  -made Bear Island a reagent haven.
  -rebalanced items among alchemy merchants.
-add Tika's Restoration side quest, potion, and recipe.
-updates to minimap.
-add missing berserk icon.
-fix the bug where if you start casting a spell and then immediately hit melee, the spell fizzles!
-FIX: you can fall off the edge of the world by jumping over the walls of the Lower Temple (Library).
-FIX: you can see bright blue sky through the walls if you stand on a bookcase in the Library and jump.
-fix big pot holes in The Docks paths.
-fix pathing issues on some mobs.
-fixed several canoe issues.
  -FIX: no regen in canoe when in totem range.
  -FIX: if you get into a canoe with totem regen on, the particle fx stays on you but no regen happens.
  -FIX: you can aggro stuff and take damage in a canoe, but can't die.
  -FIX: you can fall through the world exiting the canoe at several places at Sinking Island.
-fix issue where boat guy will keep taking your 5 gold and renting you the boat everytime you talk to him.
-fix bug where you could bring up inventory while a vision was pending, causes strange behavior.
-don't allow interactions while vision is pending. Smart interaction path was bypassing this.
-Fix bug where you can't use enchanted feathers during lost staff chapter.
-FIX: when returning with silver, map marker for Moku is in the wrong place.
-fix bug where you can't interact with Mowg trainer using auto-interact button.
-fix bug where you can't interact with Tika at all after turning down her quest.

notes.title: Build #2788 This is a big one!
notes.content:
Good news everyone! We just moved one step closer to Tanzia's release candidate! : D

Since we changed so much for this build, we recommend to all the Youtubers/Streamers who are in the middle of a Let's Play series to start over with a new savegame, trust us, it's worth it.

We literally have a ton of improvements and new stuff on this update, let me walk you through some of the changes:

[b]New Tutorial[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8805370/6d8d1f875f1820e60fe245c60628edfe3487bbae.png[/img]
Finally! This is really a big deal for us, for the longest time we had a super boring tutorial and we hated it! Now we feel that the players will leave The Village really knowing how everything works, and it doesn't feel like a chore : )

[b]Improved Quests[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8805370/7c0d2711ec07a42293da9a93fe3ddc9ccee13a4a.png[/img]
Most of the early quests have changed, some flow better, some are easier to understand, some have been completely revamped. That's why we're recommending everyone to start a fresh game, so you can experience the game as it's meant to be.

[b]New (small) Town at The Lagoon[/b]
Now there's a new settlement at The Lagoon, with NPCs who teach you spells, sell potions and even give you one of the coolest new sidequests. Go check it out!

[b]Sidequests[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8805370/c3b68dcbf823a740ac75a3caa0de0a107e709dca.png[/img]
We know people love sidequests, and we added more for all of you to enjoy. Search for lost birds, collect poop (don't ask), fix sandals, visit secret places and many more things that'll let you collect sweet sweet loot!

[b]Free floating speech balloons[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8805370/5bf88b18809d198d75e6783436df2addc71aa385.png[/img]
Tanzia's NPCs love to talk, and we put some of the color (non-crucial) text into speech balloons. Check out the guards next to the bridge during the fight there for a fun example of this ; )

[b]Known Bug[/b]
At one point you need to get on a boat (exciting!) that boat has a small bug in which sometimes it won't let you get in to ride it (sad!).
If that happens to you and you are at The Docks, just wait for it until it returns and it'll probably work fine. If you are at Bear Island you can buy one of the Magic Feathers from Tika and just teleport back to The Village in a jiffy.
Also if you jump around the boat too much, you might fall from it, so please don't, unless you love seeing bugs, if that's the case, go nuts! Hahaha.
We're fixing that for the next build, please be patient!

-add Frappy Bird quest.
-add Too Many Spiders quest.
-add Melee Practice quest.

Greetings, humans of London! (Or any human that’s planning on going to London this weekend for the #PCGW17),

       After a crazy couple of weeks of ups and downs, rushed programming, emailing, begging, not sleeping, crying and laughing (mostly crying), we can finally say for sure that Tanzia is going to be at the PC Gamer Weekender Indie Showcase for you to play!

Sadly, we, the team behind the game, won’t be able to make it to the venue, but thanks to Berenger Dupre, Tomáš Duda, Joachim Sammer, Carlos Leituga, Angi Suarez, Martin Eriksson & James Ohalloran who selflessly offered to help us set up and maintain desk J26, Tanzia will be there for you to enjoy!

We also found the lovely Marjana, who’s going to be there showing the game for us! She’ll have some business cards with Tanzia Steam beta keys, so if you see her, ask for one! (But don’t be mad if she runs out of them, we only managed to make a few!)

The build at the event will be different from the one we have on Steam: it will be the latest version, with the new tutorial in place and some super nice details like free floating speech balloons! So if you already played the current Steam beta or if you watched all the latest YouTuber videos, there’s something new for you too!

So if you’re going to PCGW17, please come to the Indie Showcase and check out Tanzia! And don’t miss out on the other awesome games that will be there! [b]Hacktag, The Great Whale Road, American Truck Simulator, Ruin and Miner Meltdown![/b] Without them Tanzia wouldn’t be at the show, so we are eternally grateful to every one of those teams!

notes.title: Gamepad Update! (And more, plenty more!)
notes.content:
Hey everyone! You wouldn’t believe how hard we worked on this update, we’re super happy to finally show it to you!


Here’s what’s new:


[b]Gamepad Controls[/b]
Finally! After weeks (months?) of tweaking and testing and swearing and breaking and fixing (and crying), we present you, the gamepad update!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8805370/7d3fc8bcae9e1716d7d08e9f831c00827b1c6a52.png[/img]
So now you can choose between the regular MMO-Style controls we all love, a FPS-style variant (where the mouse moves the camera automatically, without keeping the right button pressed).
And gamepad! Yes! You’ll be able to modify it as you please, invert it, change all the key bindings, you can even bind your spells to the digital pad and have them right at your fingertips!

By default we have two presets A and B, A was created by our lead designer Jason, and B was created by a normal person (me, Matias), so you might want to switch to B to have a better experience ; )

Think of the gamepad controls as in Beta (a Beta inside another Beta? how meta!) so things might break, please send us your feedback and comments so we can keep improving it.


[b]Tabs in the Equipment Menu[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8805370/9cdb3e5e212a76d03e0e53381b680abff7583d50.png[/img]
After lots of requests, we added tabs to the equipment menu. That used to be a big mess and people needed to navigate pages and pages to find what they were looking for, but now everything is tidy and organized!


[b]Auto Targeting[/b]
If you were one of the players who hated the “you don’t have a target” pop-up text, you’re in luck! Now if you aggro an enemy, the game will target it automatically, and if that enemy dies, and there’s another aggroed enemy around, the game will target that one.
So unless you start picking up loot or talk to an NPC, then you’ll always have a target and the fight will never stop! You’re going to love it! (I know I do!).


[b]Z-targeting / Enemy lock[/b]
Mastering kiting is super important in Tanzia (keeping an enemy chasing you while also keeping it at a range where it cannot attack you), you really need it if you plan on surviving the Emuri Village or any of the later areas. It’s super hard to kite properly using a gamepad, so we added a way to lock the camera to your target, so you can run around it and not destroy your fingers in the process. If you played Zelda64, you’ll feel right at home.


[b]Melee changes[/b]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8805370/81ed2e811042d748d99a3cb185c159cda40f99a4.png[/img]
Before, melee was treated like a spell, so you activated it, and waited for it to cool down to attack again. Now it works independently, you can attack at any time even if you don’t have a target. Using the gamepad you have a dedicated button for the attack, and best of all, now you can do a little 3-hit combo, it’s fun!


[b]We killed the pre-launcher[/b]
All the options that you used to find on the pre-launcher, now you’ll find on the settings menu.
So now Tanzia is 100% compatible with Steam’s Big Picture Mode. You can sit back, relax, and play on your couch : D

-gamepad/controller support!
-Steam Big Picture compatibility!
-equipment screen tabs to filter by item type.
-greatly improved controls configuration.
-added video settings screen.
-the bridge demon should hit you if you're on the bridge, even before chapter 3.
-fix bug where you can still attack when dead.
-added item count to hotbar.
-prevent bear from entering canoe.
-fix HUD spam that happens sometimes when Necromancer's Jewel is equipped.
-allow player to walk in the village pond.
-restore health and mana when you level.
-add a note from grandfather to the Overwatch Stone chest.
-modify the crab whistle effect for easier herding.
-add more crab spawns to The Docks.
-improve Overwatch Stone FX to help player visually notice when it fires and understand what it's doing.
-make the scroll for the purify platform glow a bit so it's more obvious.
-flatten the purify platform a bit so you can walk onto it without jumping.
-don't let player attack General Rotwart without speaking to him first.
-fix target FX height on the potion merchant in The Village.
-fix bug in Alchemy book where if you buy a new recipe and open the alchemy book, the recipe that's shown doesn't match the page until after you turn the page once.
-fix zombie boss portrait camera.
-fix bug where stone guardians fall through the world when you die.
-attempt to fix bug where stone guardian stops fighting sometimes.
-add tutorial popup that explains saving.
-turn down the music volume in The Docks.
-set demon shadowstepper to level 4 instead of level 1.
-prevent multiple visions from queuing up at once.
-fix bug where you could kill the demon shadowstepper before triggering the vision and then he'd respawn.
-add more saves to intro.
-add "when not in combat" to the totem tutorial popup.
-leave the quest description up while in the quest journal.
-allow interaction clicks to go through the PC.

notes.title: Good and Bad news!

notes.title: September Update, New Locations, New Weapons, Tons of Fixes!
notes.content:
I know we're in October already! But we're just starting the month, so it's fair to name it like that! ; )

Here's what you came for, the update list!

[h1][b]Temple Ruins[/b][/h1]
You'll finally be able to open the door that takes you to the Temple Ruins! Beware of the zombies! And also make sure to bring the key to open it from the Forgotten Jungle...

[h1][b]Sinking Island[/b][/h1]
Another island! I hope you've been working on your upper body strength, because you have to row to get there!
What's waiting for you there? We won't tell, but it will really come in handy for the rest of your adventure.

[h1][b]Ancient Library[/b][/h1]
I wanted to write something funny about returning ancient overdue books, but the place is scary enough as it is without grumpy librarians and late fees, you´ll see!


That's for the locations, we also have a ton of improvements for you to try.

[h1][b]Corpse looting[/b][/h1]
The number one request we get from every streamer is that when you slain a big enemy, sometimes it's body covers the loot bags, so you'd have to click around blindly to find it.
NO MORE! Now you can directly click on the corpse, you'll get the loot and the body will disappear! Like magic!

[h1][b]New Camera System[/b][/h1]
Before the camera was always at a fixed distance behind you, but now it will react to the environment pulling it close to you if there's a wall or any other object, so now it won't clip behind stuff like it used to! Fancy!

[b]The Emuri Village:[/b] That area was closed to beta users for super long and now you can go there! Some people already visited it and died there a lot, some went and kicked ass! Our advice before you set foot there is: Gear up! Or you're going to have a rude awakening!

[b]New lighting:[/b] We're still improving the visuals of the game a bit, and we just made some subtle lighting changes you might have noticed. It's not complete yet but you should see some flickering torches, character shadows and, if you have an artistic eye, much improved lighting all around to give Tanzia a much warmer and nicer look than before.

[b]Bug fixes and tweaks:[/b] We're always working on improving the game, there's a ton of under the hood changes/fixes we made based on feedback and all the videos we're watching from Lets Players and Streamers. We fixed quests & combat balance issues and every day we add new stuff to the list!
